verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents its own transformation orchestration: transformations can run automatically after connection syncs. That gives a built-in sync-then-transform ordering, and the hosted dbt Core integration centralizes transformation management. The evidence does not show user-defined dependency graphs across arbitrary pipeline steps and datasets, or Fivetran itself resolving multi-step run order. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined dependencies between pipeline steps and datasets, DAG-level ordering across syncs and transformations beyond the after-sync trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I define dependencies between pipeline steps and datasets, and the platform orchestrates runs in the right order

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Orchestrate pre-built and custom data transformations in your destination with Fivetran.
Use the Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration or our third-party dbt Cloud and Coalesce orchestration to centralize and manage all your transformations.
